variants.name: 星爆冲击
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 2D VFX ornament sprite for a bright cute mobile bubble-shooter game, to be animated in layers. Design ONLY the free-form celebratory ornament, no text, no numbers, no UI panel.
Style: premium casual mobile game, soft rounded toy-like forms, glossy translucent candy-glass and jelly, pearly white highlights, polished hand-painted 2.5D, sky-blue and turquoise base with warm honey-gold accents and tiny lavender/coral accents. Friendly, lively, celebratory; matches a pastel sky-and-clouds bubble shooter with shiny blue, yellow and purple jelly creatures and frosted glass interface.
Composition: one centered wide ornament in a square 1024 canvas, silhouette within the central 90% width and 70% height, front view, center reserved as a TRANSPARENT CLEAR OPEN SPACE occupying about 42% width by 24% height for later dynamic numeric typography. Around the center use expressive separately readable forms. Alpha background genuinely transparent; internal openings also transparent. Crisp readable silhouette at 360px, generous padding. No background atmosphere or environment.
Avoid: rectangles, capsules, modal windows, blank plaque, banner/ribbon, lettering, numbers, logos, photorealism, dark metal, sharp military weapons, dirty smoke, realistic fire, over-detailed tiny noise.
Variant: A powerful radial starburst of rounded inflated honey-gold and orange candy flame petals, luminous white-gold at their bases, bursting OUTWARD. Broad three-dimensional rounded star rays sweep diagonally toward corners; small cyan glass bubbles and 4-point gold twinkles fly outward around the ends. Strong compact explosive shape with a clear center hole, warm amber-yellow dominant but framed in icy-blue shine. The top has one rounded flaming star flare and lower sides two smaller flames. It must feel like joyful released energy, not a badge or shield.
